description: This source file defines the CheckOutHelper class, which serves as a facade over the shopping cart to simplify complex order creation and checkout processes in the OFBiz framework. It includes methods for setting shipping addresses, shipping options, payment methods, dates, and creating orders, as well as handling taxes and payments.

classes.name: CheckOutHelper
classes.description: Main class providing methods to facilitate order checkout, including setting addresses, shipping options, payments, and creating orders.

methods.name: setCheckOutShippingAddress
methods.description: Sets the shipping address for checkout based on a contact mech ID.

methods.name: setCheckOutShippingAddressInternal
methods.description: Internal helper for setting the shipping contact mech ID, returning error messages if applicable.

methods.name: setCheckOutShippingOptions
methods.description: Sets shipping options including method, instructions, gift message, and dates.

methods.name: setCheckOutShippingOptionsInternal
methods.description: Internal method to set shipping method, instructions, gift options, date preferences, and additional emails.

methods.name: setCheckOutPayment
methods.description: Configures the payment methods, single use payments, and billing account for checkout.

methods.name: setCheckOutPaymentInternal
methods.description: Internal method to set payment options, including validation against account balances and handling of different payment method types.

methods.name: setCheckOutDates
methods.description: Sets the shipping before and after date for the order.

methods.name: setCheckOutOptions
methods.description: Sets comprehensive checkout options, including shipping, address, payments, and recalculating taxes and shipping costs.

methods.name: checkGiftCard
methods.description: Handles gift card validation, creation, and applying gift card payments in the checkout process.

methods.name: createOrder
methods.description: Creates a new order from the current shopping cart, with optional parameters for order attributes.

methods.name: processPayment
methods.description: Processes the payment for the current order, supporting different configurations including face-to-face and manual holds.

methods.name: adjustFaceToFacePayment
methods.description: Adjusts face-to-face payment preferences to match the order total, creating a payment preference if needed.

methods.name: checkOrderDenyList
methods.description: Checks if the shipping address or credit card info is on a denylist and rejects the order if so.

methods.name: checkOrderDenylist
methods.description: Deprecated method alias for checkOrderDenyList.

methods.name: failedDenylistCheck
methods.description: Handles the failure of a denylist check by disabling user login, rejecting the order, and clearing the cart.

methods.name: checkExternalPayment
methods.description: Verifies if the order has an external payment method (like external PayPal) and returns its type.

methods.name: finalizeOrderEntryShip
methods.description: Sets shipping contact mechanism details and supplier info for a given ship group.

methods.name: finalizeOrderEntryOptions
methods.description: Sets order options such as shipping method, instructions, gift message, gift status, internal code, and shipping dates for a specific ship group.

methods.name: finalizeOrderEntryOptions (overload with additional params)
methods.description: Sets shipping estimates and then calls the main finalizeOrderEntryOptions.

methods.name: finalizeOrderEntryOptions (main method)
methods.description: Completes setting various shipping options and internal notes, also handling date formatting and validation.

methods.name: finalizeOrderEntryPayment
methods.description: Sets the payment ID for the cart, optionally appending to existing payments.

methods.name: availableAccountBalance
methods.description: Calculates the available balance for a billing account using sync service call.

methods.name: availableAccountBalance (instance method)
methods.description: Calls the static method with the current delegator.

methods.name: makeBillingAccountMap
methods.description: Creates a map of billing account IDs to maximum amounts from payment preferences.

methods.name: validatePaymentMethods
methods.description: Validates that account balances, gift cards, and payment amounts satisfy order requirements, adjusting payment info as needed.

methods.name: validateGiftCardAmounts
methods.description: Checks gift card balances via external services and updates payment amounts accordingly.
